fact: The updated SN2025 action plan lists the elaboration of a national high and very high speed broadband plan among its main achievements and sets 90% 4G population coverage by end 2024 and 100% of priority villages by 2025, with a financing plan.
title: Actualisation de la stratégie Sénégal numérique 2025 (SN2025) - Plan d'actions
publisher: Ministère de l'Économie numérique et des Télécommunications, République du Sénégal
